rounds: A beautiful object that is hard to use can still be good design.
I would pay more for something that looks good, even if it works exactly the same.
If you need instructions to use something, the designer has failed.
Expensive design is mostly for showing off.
Berlin needs more bold, strange buildings, even if lots of people hate them.
I would rather live in a beautiful old building than a practical new one.
Phones have made us worse at finding our way without help.
I would rather design how things work than how they look.
